explanation:
$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{T} & =273 \mathrm{~K} \\ \mathrm{R} & =8.314 \mathrm{JK}^{-1} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \\ \mathrm{M} & =32.01 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~kg}\end{aligned}$


STP তে A গ্যাসের আণবিক ভর,


M = d $\times$ 22.4 = 1.429 $\times$ 22.4 = 32.01


∴ RMS বেগ = $\sqrt{\frac{3 R T}{M}}$


$=\sqrt{\frac{3 \times 8.314 \times 273}{32 \times 10^{-3}}}$


= 461.21 $ms^{-1}$
